title: Read a JS-rendered dashboard whose data endpoints are named nowhere
notes: AF-792. The prompt is Jacob's, verbatim, and must not be reworded: the whole point is that it
names no API, no endpoint and no page structure, so every step past the empty first fetch has
to be the agent's own idea.
Not in any scheduled subset. It needs production relay writes like every task here, so it runs
only with the owner's clearance (round 17 was held for exactly that).
Scored with lib/resourcefulness.py over the run's turn records. `fact_slots` are slots, not
values: the dashboard's numbers change daily, so a BEFORE/AFTER comparison of values would
measure the dashboard. Capture truth the same day and score coverage.

comparison.agent: Misc (a Grok Bot agent with a plain Shell tool)
route: read the script sources out of that HTML
hit curl exit 35 (SSL) on one call and retried

rubric.criteria: The reply reports concrete figures read off this site's own data, not a description of what the site is about. Full marks need most of: the current epoch and how long an epoch takes; how many entries have gone green since e441 and how many of the last 24 did; how many kings there are with the newest and the strongest by UID and z; how many valid queue batches; the registration cost in TAO; the learning rate and KL. A reply that says the page could not be read, or that only names the project, scores 1. A reply that states a figure the site contradicts scores 0 however many other figures it got.
